description:
Log in to OSCAR EMR (username: oscardoc, password: oscar, PIN: 1117) and discontinue an active medication for patient Margaret Thompson.

- Date of Birth: 1958-07-22

Medication to Discontinue:
- Drug: METFORMIN 500 mg (metformin HCl)
- Current Dosage: 500 mg twice daily (BID), oral
- Status: Currently active

Task:
1. Log in to OSCAR EMR
2. Search for patient Margaret Thompson and open her chart
3. Navigate to her Medications/Prescriptions (Rx) section
4. Find the active Metformin 500 mg prescription
5. Discontinue (archive) the Metformin prescription
6. Enter the reason for discontinuation: GI side effects (nausea, diarrhea)
7. Save the discontinuation

The patient has been experiencing persistent gastrointestinal side effects from the Metformin including nausea, diarrhea, and abdominal cramping. The prescribing provider has decided to discontinue this medication. Make sure the reason for discontinuation references the GI side effects.
